checks.name: line breaks: faces used
checks.definition: Faces with '/' and no '[', ']' or '000'; lines split on '/', signs on '-', reversed unless L/R. Found = contiguous in a distinct clean text whose family set is not exactly this face's family. Line windows: each line of length >= 2. Straddle windows: per adjacent pair and order, windows of length len(A) and len(B) (each >= 2) crossing the junction. Better order = higher of the per-face forward and reverse straddle rates.

diagnosis.line_rate_disagreement: The run's linebreaks.py appends line windows inside the loop over adjacent line pairs (for L in (A, B)), so a line between two others is counted twice. Four of the 72 faces have three or more lines. Counting each line once gives 133 line windows, mean line rate 0.22685 and pooled line rate 0.24060; the run reports 137, 0.22917 and 0.24818. recompute.py reproduces the run's values exactly when interior lines are counted twice (check5_diagnostic_interior_lines_twice). The face-level sign counts (23 vs 4 and 25 vs 3) and p-values are the same under both countings.
